goal.en: Ask Mr. Lin the right questions about the studio before you decide.
goal.zh: 決定之前，向林先生問清楚套房的重要條件。

background: small empty studio apartment with wooden floor, single bed frame, compact kitchenette, old white radiator heater under a large window, bare white walls, warm afternoon sunlight

intro.en: After months of sharing a flat with Mia, you're ready for a place of your own. Today you're viewing a studio on Cedar Street.
intro.zh: 和米亞合租了幾個月後，你準備好擁有自己的小窩了。今天你要去看雪松街上的一間套房。

intro.en: You must be Kai. I'm Mr. Lin, the owner. Come in and take a look around.
intro.zh: 你一定是凱吧。我是房東林先生。進來，隨便看看。

lines.en: This is it. Kitchen on the left, bathroom on the right. The rent is 1,200 dollars a month.
lines.zh: 就是這間。左邊是廚房，右邊是浴室。房租每個月 1,200 元。
房租方面有什麼問題嗎？

choices.en: Are utilities included, or do I pay for those separately?
choices.zh: 有包含水電瓦斯嗎？還是要另外付？
choices.tip: utilities 是水、電、瓦斯等費用的統稱，問 Are utilities included? 最精準。

choices.en: Is the water money and electricity money also inside the rent?
choices.zh: 水錢跟電錢也在房租裡面嗎？

lines.en: Water money? Inside the rent? Oh, you mean the utilities?
lines.zh: 水錢？在房租裡面？喔，你是說水電費嗎？

story.en: Mr. Lin starts explaining the history of the building's water pipes. By the time he finishes, the sun has set and you still don't know the answer.
story.zh: 林先生開始講解這棟樓水管的歷史。等他講完，天都黑了，你還是不知道答案。

fail.why: 「水錢、電錢」是中文直譯，英文不這樣說。水、電、瓦斯等費用統稱 utilities，問房東時說 Are utilities included? 就好。

choices.en: Excuse me, how much the utilities is cost every month?
choices.zh: 請問，水電費每個月多少錢？

lines.en: The utilities is... what? Sorry, could you say that again?
lines.zh: 水電費是……什麼？抱歉，可以再說一次嗎？

story.en: You try three more versions of the question. Mr. Lin politely nods at each one and answers a completely different question.
story.zh: 你又換了三種問法。林先生每次都客氣地點頭，然後回答了完全不同的問題。

fail.why: 問價錢的句型是 How much do / does + 主詞 + cost?，is 和 cost 不能放在一起。可以說 How much do the utilities cost?，或直接問 Are utilities included?

lines.en: Utilities are included. Internet isn't, so you'll need to set that up yourself.
lines.zh: 水電瓦斯有包含，網路沒有，要你自己申辦。

lines.en: Anything else you'd like to know?

choices.en: Is it furnished? I don't have any furniture of my own yet.
choices.zh: 這裡有附家具嗎？我自己還沒有任何家具。
choices.tip: furnished 就是「附家具」，一個字就問清楚，比一件一件問更有效率。

choices.en: Is it with furnitures? Because I don't have any furnitures yet.
choices.zh: 有附家具嗎？因為我還沒有家具。

lines.en: Furnitures? You mean furniture? Well, there's a bed, I suppose.
lines.zh: Furnitures？你是說家具嗎？嗯，有一張床吧。

story.en: Mr. Lin corrects your grammar for the next fifteen minutes, just like your old English teacher. You forget to ask about the sofa.
story.zh: 接下來十五分鐘，林先生像你以前的英文老師一樣幫你改文法。你忘了問沙發的事。

fail.why: furniture 是不可數名詞，不能加 s，也不能說 a furniture。問有沒有附家具，最自然的說法是 Is it furnished?

choices.en: Be honest, has anyone ever died in this apartment before?
choices.zh: 老實說，以前有人在這間房子過世嗎？

lines.en: Excuse me? No! Why would you ask me something like that?
lines.zh: 什麼？沒有！你怎麼會問這種問題？

story.en: Mr. Lin's face turns red. He suddenly remembers another appointment, and the viewing ends very quickly.
story.zh: 林先生臉都紅了。他突然想起還有別的約，看房就這樣匆匆結束。

fail.why: 在台灣問「是不是凶宅」很常見，但在楓灣第一次見面就這樣問，房東會覺得被冒犯。真的在意，可以之後委婉地問 Is there anything I should know about the apartment?

lines.en: It comes with a bed, a desk and a small sofa. The last tenant kept everything in great shape.
lines.zh: 附一張床、一張書桌和一張小沙發。上一位房客都保持得很好。

lines.en: What else is on your mind?

choices.en: When is it available? I'd like to move in by the first.
choices.zh: 什麼時候可以入住？我希望一號前搬進來。
choices.tip: 租屋時 available 指「可以開始租」，When is it available? 是問入住日期的標準說法。

choices.en: When can I check in? I hope I can come on the first.
choices.zh: 我什麼時候可以入住？希望一號就能來。

lines.en: Check in? This isn't a hotel, Kai. There's no front desk here.
lines.zh: Check in？這裡不是飯店，凱。這裡沒有櫃檯。

story.en: For the rest of the viewing, Mr. Lin calls you "our hotel guest." He even asks if you'd like breakfast included.
story.zh: 整場看房，林先生都叫你「我們的飯店貴賓」，還問你要不要附早餐。

fail.why: 把「入住」翻成 check in 是飯店用語。租屋問入住日期要說 When is it available? 或 When can I move in?

choices.en: Fine, I'll take it. Just give me the keys right now, okay?
choices.zh: 好啦，我租了。現在就把鑰匙給我，好嗎？

lines.en: Right now? Slow down. We haven't even talked about the lease.
lines.zh: 現在？慢一點。我們連租約都還沒談。

story.en: Mr. Lin quietly puts the keys back in his pocket. He says he'll "think about it" and calls the next person on his list.
story.zh: 林先生默默把鑰匙收回口袋。他說會「考慮看看」，然後打給名單上的下一位。

fail.why: Give me the keys right now 聽起來像命令，對第一次見面的房東太衝。想表達很有意願，可以說 I'm really interested. When is it available?

lines.en: It's available from the first of next month. Two other people are coming to see it this weekend.
lines.zh: 下個月一號起就可以入住。這週末還有兩個人要來看。

choices.en: Yes, I'm interested. Could I let you know by tomorrow?
choices.zh: 有，我有興趣。可以明天前給你答覆嗎？
choices.tip: Could I let you know by...? 禮貌地爭取考慮時間，同時給對方明確的期限。

choices.en: Yes, I'm very interesting in it. Can I tell you tomorrow?
choices.zh: 有，我很有興趣。明天告訴你可以嗎？

lines.en: You're very interesting? Well... I'm sure you are.
lines.zh: 你很有趣？嗯……我相信你是。

story.en: Mr. Lin tells the weekend visitor about "the very interesting student." They both laugh, and the visitor signs first.
story.zh: 林先生跟週末來看房的人聊起「那位很有趣的學生」。兩人笑成一團，結果對方先簽了約。

fail.why: interesting 是「令人覺得有趣」，interested 才是「感到有興趣」。說自己有興趣要用 I'm interested in it.。

choices.en: It's small and kind of old. Maybe you can lower the rent?
choices.zh: 這裡小小的又有點舊，房租可以算便宜一點嗎？

lines.en: Old? I painted every wall myself last month. The rent stays the same.
lines.zh: 舊？上個月每面牆都是我親手漆的。房租不變。

story.en: Mr. Lin rents the studio to the weekend visitor, who called it "lovely." You spend another month scrolling rental apps.
story.zh: 林先生把套房租給了週末來看房、一直說「好可愛」的人。你又滑了一個月的租屋 app。

fail.why: 台灣有「嫌貨才是買貨人」的說法，但在楓灣當面嫌房子小又舊，房東只會覺得被冒犯。想談價錢，先說喜歡，再問 Is the rent negotiable at all?

lines.en: Of course. But don't wait too long, Kai. Good places go fast around here.
lines.zh: 當然可以。不過別等太久，凱。這附近的好房子很搶手。

lines.en: The next morning, you call Mr. Lin and say yes.
lines.zh: 隔天一早，你打電話給林先生，說你要租。

story.en: The studio is almost yours. Mr. Lin asks you to come by on Saturday to read and sign the lease.
story.zh: 套房幾乎是你的了。林先生請你星期六過去，看過租約再簽名。

notes.explain: utilities 指水、電、瓦斯等費用（有時也包含網路）。看房時問清楚，才知道每個月實際要付多少。

example.en: Are utilities included in the rent?
example.zh: 房租有包含水電瓦斯費嗎？

notes.explain: furnished 表示附家具。furniture 是不可數名詞，不能加 s，要說 a piece of furniture。

example.en: Is the apartment furnished or unfurnished?
example.zh: 這間公寓有附家具還是沒有？

notes.explain: available 在租屋情境指「可以開始租」。「入住」別說 check in，那是飯店用語，租屋要說 move in。

example.en: The room is available from June 1st, so you can move in then.
example.zh: 房間六月一日起可以租，你那時就能搬進來。

notes.explain: -ed 形容人的感受，-ing 形容人事物的特質。I'm interesting. 是「我這個人很有趣」，不是「我有興趣」。

example.en: I'm interested in the studio. The neighborhood is interesting, too.
example.zh: 我對這間套房有興趣，這一區也很有意思。

notes.explain: 台灣有「嫌貨才是買貨人」的說法，但在楓灣當面批評房東的房子，只會讓對方覺得被冒犯。想談價錢，先表達喜歡，再禮貌地問 Is the rent negotiable?

example.en: I really like the place. Is the rent negotiable at all?
example.zh: 我很喜歡這裡。房租有商量的空間嗎？
